# Sideways

> A drift-first arcade rally game that runs in the browser: low-poly 3D
> stages generated fresh every day — hairpins, jumps, fords — playable on
> phone and desktop, installable as a PWA, offline once loaded. No account,
> no download, free.

The game boots straight into a stage. Two cars ship at launch: an automatic
and a manual. Stages are built by a seeded rules engine that respects rally
reality — braking zones before hairpins, run-ups before jumps, fords only on
straights — so every seed is drivable flat out.

## Play

- [Play Sideways](https://game2.niclaslindstedt.se/): the game itself.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/game2): engine, stage
  generator, simulation harness, and the PWA shell. Noncommercial license.
